answer: Stop Sybils with a comb-maker's horn cutting. A newcomer cuts 20 combs over 26 days, and two comb-makers from different workshops measure every comb's 40 teeth within 1 millimeter, logging each comb in the register beside an onyx stamp. A comb with more than 3 broken teeth loses its credit and pauses cutting 14 days; three broken combs void the tally. Faking 1,000 agents takes 20,000 combs and 40,000 checks, about $180,000 in wages, while one honest agent keeps cutting. Like a dune that holds its shape at the wharf while loose sand washes away, only work that was truly done survives.
